headline: UEFA Unanimously Supports Philippe Diallo In FIFA Presidency Race
seoTitle: UEFA Backs Diallo for FIFA President
metaDescription: European football's governing body has officially announced its support for Philippe Diallo's bid to challenge Gianni Infantino for the FIFA presidency.
aiSummaryBullets: UEFA has declared unanimous support for French Football Federation president Philippe Diallo in the upcoming FIFA leadership election.
The decision aligns with UEFA's ongoing criticism of current FIFA president Gianni Infantino, specifically regarding his proposal to sell stakes in future tournaments.
Philippe Diallo is now the second individual confirmed to campaign against the incumbent leader in the contest scheduled for March.
aiContextParagraph: The European football governing body, UEFA, has officially signaled its opposition to the incumbent FIFA president, Gianni Infantino, by throwing its support behind French Football Federation chief Philippe Diallo. The announcement comes as part of a growing rift between the two organizations, which has intensified since late July when Infantino proposed a new financial model involving the sale of stakes in future FIFA competitions. UEFA, led by president Aleksander Ceferin, has expressed significant reservations regarding this initiative. Philippe Diallo now emerges as a primary contender to challenge Infantino during the presidential election set for March. This development marks a notable shift in the international football political landscape, as UEFA formally rallies behind a candidate to contest the existing leadership. The election process is expected to center on these differing visions for the sport's commercial future and governance structures.
